name: Confocal Z-Stack Projection and Depth Profiling
description:
You are a neuroscientist analyzing a confocal z-stack of a Drosophila brain. Open the built-in 'Fly Brain' sample in Fiji (File > Open Samples > Fly Brain). This is a 3D stack. Your task is to generate four specific outputs to characterize the data:

1. Create a Maximum Intensity Projection (MIP) of the entire stack and save as ~/ImageJ_Data/results/fly_brain_MIP.tif
2. Create an Average Intensity Projection (AVG) of the entire stack and save as ~/ImageJ_Data/results/fly_brain_AVG.tif
3. Perform an Orthogonal Reslice (Image > Stacks > Reslice) to create an XZ view (top-down cross-section) and save the result as ~/ImageJ_Data/results/fly_brain_reslice_XZ.tif
4. Create a Montage (Image > Stacks > Make Montage) showing a subset of slices (e.g., every 5th slice) and save as ~/ImageJ_Data/results/fly_brain_montage.tif
5. Measure the mean intensity of each slice across the z-depth (Image > Stacks > Plot Z-axis Profile) and save the values as a CSV file to ~/ImageJ_Data/results/fly_brain_z_profile.csv
